category_name_taken: A category with this name already exists.
brand_name_taken: A brand with this name already exists.
location_not_found: One of the selected locations doesn't exist.
tax_not_found: One of the selected taxes doesn't exist.
variant_not_found: One of the variants doesn't belong to this product.
invalid_variants_for_type: This product type doesn't match the submitted variants or components.
options_required: Add at least one option with values for a variable product.
invalid_option_values: Each variant needs one value for every option, taken from that option's values.
duplicate_variant: Two variants have the same option values.
duplicate_location: A variant has the same location listed twice.
components_required: Add at least one compositing product.
duplicate_component: The same product is listed twice as a component.
component_not_found: One of the compositing products doesn't exist.
component_cannot_be_composite: A composite product can't contain another composite product.
duplicate_identifier_in_request: SKUs and barcodes must all be different from each other.
identifier_taken: This SKU or barcode is already used by another product
variant_in_use_by_composite: This product is used in a composite product — remove it from there first.
import_missing_columns: The file needs at least a "Product Name" and "SKU" column.
import_too_many_rows: The file has too many rows for one import.
import_missing_required: Product Name and SKU are required.
category_depth_exceeded: Categories can be nested up to 3 levels (category, sub-category, sub-sub-category).
duplicate_category_name: Two categories at the same level have the same name.
product_not_found: One of the selected products doesn't exist.
